args.title: Payments API errors after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: Payments API (payments-api) has been throwing errors since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0. Current error rate 18% and service unhealthy in all regions. Rolling back to last healthy release v5.0.0.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Identified the service**: The affected service is `payments-api` (the name "payments" wasn't recognized). It was running v5.1.0, unhealthy with an 18% error rate across all regions.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `payments-api` back to **v5.0.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v5.1.0 was the only degraded release, deployed this morning). The rollback completed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** — "Payments API errors after v5.1.0 deploy" — which paged the on-call engineer.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows v5.0.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.

Note: the rollback to v5.0.0 is a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
